description: Enable concurrent agent execution via agent pool with queue support

tasks.title: Refactor AgentRunnerService to use Map-based tracking
tasks.description: Replace single activePromise/activeIssueId with activeAgents Map. Add RunningAgent interface with issueId, issueNumber, promise, projectId. Modify isRunning(), getStatus(), getActiveIssueId() to use the new structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing pause/resume behavior works for single agent
AgentRunnerService.isRunning() returns true when agent is running
tasks.notes: Keep existing methods signature compatible where possible

tasks.title: Add maxConcurrentAgents configuration
tasks.description: Pass maxConcurrentAgents to AgentRunnerService constructor. Update server/index.ts to pass config.getMaxConcurrentAgents(). Default to 8.
acceptanceCriteria: Server logs show configured maxConcurrentAgents value

tasks.title: Implement queue data structure and processing
tasks.description: Add agentQueue array. Add processQueue() helper. When agent completes, check queue and start next if any. Queue stores issue context needed for start.
acceptanceCriteria: When agent at capacity completes, queued agent starts automatically
tasks.notes: Queue is FIFO, no priority support in M1

tasks.title: Update start() to queue when at capacity
tasks.description: Modify start() to check activeAgents.size vs maxConcurrentAgents. If at capacity, add to queue instead of throwing error.
acceptanceCriteria: start() does not throw when at capacity
Agent is added to queue and started when capacity frees up
tasks.notes: Remove the 'Agent already running' error check

tasks.title: Update API for queue response
tasks.description: Update /issues/:number/start API to return 202 Accepted with queue position. Add queuePosition and runningAgents to response.
acceptanceCriteria: When queued, response includes message with queue position
When immediate start, response indicates agent started
tasks.notes: Added 409 guard for already-running agents; queue message uses position/maxConcurrentAgents format per design spec; immediate start also includes queuePosition:0 and runningAgents for consistency

tasks.title: Update resume() for concurrent safety
tasks.description: Update resume() to check capacity but still allow resume of paused session. Paused sessions take priority over queued agents.
acceptanceCriteria: resume() works when other agents are running
Paused session resume does not count toward capacity
tasks.notes: Resume bypasses queue, takes slot from pausedSessions
